title: Finding Peace in Prayer After a Hard Day
paragraphs: After a stressful meeting where his proposal was rejected in front of the whole team, Yusuf felt embarrassed and frustrated for the rest of the afternoon, replaying the moment repeatedly in his mind.
When Maghrib arrived, he almost skipped his prayer, still too irritated to focus properly, but he forced himself to stop and pray anyway, hoping it might calm his racing thoughts.
Standing quietly in prayer, away from his phone and his coworkers, Yusuf slowly felt his frustration soften, replaced by a calmer, more accepting feeling about the disappointing day.
He did not suddenly stop caring about the rejected proposal, but the sharp edge of his frustration had noticeably faded by the time he finished praying that evening.
Yusuf later told his wife that prayer did not erase his problem, but it gave him enough calm to think about tomorrow's presentation without the same bitterness he felt earlier.
